children: Following are the results of the Philippine Bureau of the Treasury's (BTr) auction of cash management and Treasury bills on Tuesday:
BTr awards 49.58 billion pesos ($795 million) of bills, below the indicated offer of 52 to 80 billion pesos of bills, of which:
BTr awards 8.25 billion pesos worth of 35-day cash management bills at an average rate of 5.036% versus previous rate of 4.823%, below the 10-20 billion pesos programme.
Tenders for cash management bills total 10.85 billion pesos
BTr awards 41.33 billion pesos worth of T-bills, below the 42-60 billion pesos programme:
BTr awards 16.33 billion pesos of 91-day T-bills at avg rate of 5.138% versus previous auction avg of 5.051%
BTr awards 15  billion pesos of 182-day T-bills at avg rate of 5.517% versus previous auction avg of 5.433%
BTr awards 10 billion pesos of 364-day T-bills at avg rate of 5.717% versus previous auction avg of 5.640%
Details are on the BTr's website www.treasury.gov.ph
